notes: Election made on a timely Form 706; Rev. Proc. 2022-32 allows a late portability-only election up to the 5th anniversary of death (per IRS Estate Tax FAQs). Married transferors can therefore shelter up to 2 x the exclusion.

notes: Applies above MAGI of $250,000 (MFJ) / $200,000 (single); thresholds are NOT indexed for inflation. Rental income and gains on sale of rental/investment property are NII.

item: Exclusion of gain on sale of principal residence (sec. 121)
source_title: IRS Topic no. 701 - Sale of your home
notes: Requires ownership and use as main home for at least 2 of the 5 years before sale. Not available for rented units/periods of non-qualified use.
